reasoning: The question asks if a major tech company (besides Anthropic) will report 98%+ AI-generated code before April 1, 2026. As of March 6, 2026, this leaves ~25 days. Current AI coding tools like Copilot assist developers but don't generate 98% of code autonomously. The clarification requires AI to be the primary agent, not just assisting. While companies report high AI assistance rates (e.g., 40-50% code suggestions accepted), 98% AI-generated is an extreme threshold. No major company has made such a claim yet, and it's unlikely in the remaining timeframe.
